Status: Wave 314 accepted (6.3): the IndividualAddressDownload task and its contracts

Method.evidence: Five type names and five accessor/task names for the IndividualAddressDownload task. Class470 names itself through its own logger-category literal ('...IndividualAddressDownload.IoTIndividualAddressDownloadTask', the same stale literal 6.4's class carries) and its member set is 6.4 IoTIndividualAddressDownloader field for field, in order: programming-mode manager, serial-number retriever, occupied-address handler, 5 s timeout, two bools, logger, task state, project data, data facade, load-device delegates, async network provider, device programming state. Its declaration Class470 : Interface16 matches 6.4 IIoTIndividualAddressDownloader member for member (manager getter, TimeSpan, two bools, void RestoreProgrammingState, Task PerformIoTDeviceIndividualizationProcedure), and Interface17/Interface18 are the single-member contracts of the two collaborator fields (RetrieveSerialNumberViaProgrammingModeAndPerformChecks, HandleIndividualAddressBeingAlreadyOccupiedAsync - the latter already implemented under that name). Interface19 (Class474 : Interface19) is IIoTApplicationProgramDownloader. Two more task methods match 6.4 by signature: RetrieveSerialNumberViaProgrammingModeAndPerformChecks(IoTOperationToken) and WriteIndividualAddressToDevice(SerialNumber, IndividualAddress, IoTOperationToken).
Method.themes: The IndividualAddressDownload twin of wave 312/313, and the whitelist keeps two more rows obfuscated: ls is 6.4 Knx.Ets.Hawk.DataProvider.DeviceProgrammingState (one DateTime + five bool property pairs, serialized by Class490) and its getter would name it, but the SDK whitelist protects the type, so both stay. The remaining free rows in this cluster are the obfuscated 6.4 methods (Class470::method_5/6/7/8/9 - device/network retrieval, address availability check, secure-key preparation, state restore) which need behaviour evidence, and Class470's Interface10/Interface17/18/24 accessors are now named.
